# Jan Mikeš

> Jan Mikeš is a tech founder and software architect based in Ostrava, Czech Republic, building for the web for over twenty years. He builds products end to end, from the database migration to the pricing page, and is most useful on legacy code. He trained at Salesforce and Oracle in San Francisco and at Google in Palo Alto.

Key facts:
- Based in Ostrava, Czech Republic. Speaks Czech and English.
- Built MySpeedPuzzling (https://myspeedpuzzling.com), the largest speed puzzling community database in the world: bootstrapped, past 11,000 users, web, iOS and Android apps on one codebase, fully open source (https://github.com/MySpeedPuzzling/myspeedpuzzling.com). It deploys from push to production in about two and a half minutes.
- Products: SorticAI (AI regulatory oversight and readiness assessments for law firms and boards), VMCorp (production AI agent systems and cloud architecture), AUTiX (cloud business management software for companies and e-shops), Sendvery (DMARC and email authentication monitoring), wboost (locked brand templates that designers hand over for clients to edit), Fajnesklady (self-storage units with round-the-clock access). Also does consulting and advisory work.
- Works with: PHP, Symfony, PostgreSQL, PHPStan, CI/CD, Docker, self-hosting on Hetzner, AI-assisted development with Claude Code, RAG.
- Contact: j.mikes@me.com · +420 773 686 207 · https://github.com/janmikes · https://www.linkedin.com/in/jan-mikes/

## Talks
- [Running Claude Code for days on a clean context](https://janmikes.cz/slides/clean-context/): Tech Meetup #43, 9 September 2026. One autonomous Claude Code session for a week, the orchestrator pattern, eight rules for clean context.
- [A vývojáři nebudou mít co žrát (Will developers be jobless?)](https://janmikes.cz/slides/devs-will-have-nothing-to-eat/): Tech Meetup #43, 9 September 2026, in Czech. Autonomous coding agents and what they mean for engineers.
- [A homemade AI chatbot with Symfony, RAG and OCR](https://janmikes.cz/slides/homemade-ai-chatbot/): Tech Meetup #39, Impact Hub Ostrava, 28 January 2026. A self-hosted municipal chatbot, about 100 conversations a day for about $3 a month.
- [How to build a micro SaaS, brick by brick](https://janmikes.cz/slides/micro-saas/): TechMeetup Ostrava #33, Ostrava, 29 January 2025, in Czech. From idea to MVP: how to build a small, profitable SaaS on your own, next to a day job.
- [Modern PHP web servers](https://janmikes.cz/slides/php-web-servers/): php.live plus 2024, Ostrava, 17 May 2024, in Czech. Apache, Nginx, Caddy, NGINX Unit and FrankenPHP compared: architecture, strengths, benchmarks, and which one to pick.
- [Fast database tests with PHPUnit, Nette and Doctrine](https://janmikes.cz/slides/fast-database-tests-phpunit/): #posobota s06e04, Ostrava, 27 April 2024, in Czech. A PHPUnit extension that prepares the database once, rolls back every test and caches the schema between runs.
- [Continuous Deployment is the best!](https://janmikes.cz/slides/continuous-deployment/): #posobota s04e08, Pardubice, 26 November 2022, in Czech. A highly opinionated case for deploying on every push: the benefits, the excuses, and the tooling.
- [Real-time updates with Mercure and Symfony UX Turbo](https://janmikes.cz/slides/mercure-symfony-ux-turbo/): TechMeetup Ostrava Conference 2022, Ostrava, 21 October 2022, in Czech. Mercure, server-sent events and Turbo Streams: live job status in a Symfony app without writing JavaScript.
- [PHP app architecture: Symfony + DDD + CQRS, no event sourcing needed](https://janmikes.cz/slides/php-app-architecture-cqrs/): Péhápkaři, Pardubice, 8 September 2022, in Czech. Clear layers, a command bus, a Doctrine write model and a plain SQL read model. CQRS in Symfony without event sourcing.
- [Application Performance Monitoring with OpenTelemetry](https://janmikes.cz/slides/apm-opentelemetry/): TechMeetup Ostrava #23, Ostrava, 8 June 2022, in Czech. Observability, traces and spans, and how OpenTelemetry’s SDK, exporters and collector fit together, with PHP examples.
- [CI in a monorepo with GitLab parent-child pipelines](https://janmikes.cz/slides/gitlab-ci-parent-child-pipelines/): php.live 2021, Ostrava, 1 October 2021, in Czech. Parent-child and dynamic child pipelines in GitLab CI: what they are, why they help, and how they fit a monorepo.
- [Ultra-fast Docker on a Mac with an Ubuntu VM](https://janmikes.cz/slides/docker-in-ubuntu-vm/): #posobota s03e03, online, 27 March 2021, in Czech. Slow Docker Desktop for Mac, the usual fixes, and a local Ubuntu VM as a remote Docker host: from 160 s to 85 ms.
- [Your own GitHub Action: a quick start](https://janmikes.cz/slides/docker-github-action/): #posobota s02e05, online, 28 November 2020, in Czech. Build a Docker container GitHub Action in three steps: a tool, a Dockerfile and action.yml.
- [Save $$$ with Dokku](https://janmikes.cz/slides/dokku/): Cloud Native Prague #9, online, 23 March 2020. Dokku as a self-hosted Heroku: when it’s enough, and a real bill of $3,960 versus $520.
- [Sentry 2.0 in Nette 3.0](https://janmikes.cz/slides/sentry-in-nette/): Péhápkaři Prague meetup #39, Prague, 8 August 2019, in Czech. The three ways an error reaches Tracy in Nette, and one logger service that sends them all to Sentry.
- [Build your own GitHub bot](https://janmikes.cz/slides/build-your-own-github-bot/): Péhápkaři Prague meetup #38, Prague, 20 June 2019, in Czech. A GitHub App that fixes your code on push and opens a pull request: webhooks, auth and the Git Data API.
- [Migrating a legacy PHP project to PSR-4 with scripts and Rector](https://janmikes.cz/slides/psr-4-migration-with-rector/): Jobs Dev 2019, Prague, 18 May 2019, in Czech. From Nette RobotLoader to Composer classmap to PSR-4: the plan, the scripts, the Rector config and the edge cases.
- [How we migrated from Nette to Symfony like ninjas](https://janmikes.cz/slides/nette-to-symfony-like-ninjas/): Péhápkaři Prague meetup #35, Prague, 14 March 2019, in Czech. Nette to Symfony in 13 working days with Rector: the timeline, the manual work and the WTFs.
- [How we write REST APIs with TDD](https://janmikes.cz/slides/tdd-rest-api-testing/): HUBBR Developer Day 2018, Havlíčkův Brod, 20 October 2018, in Czech. From zero tests to a JSON-driven test for every API endpoint, written before the code.
- [Auto-deploying to Google App Engine with GitLab CI](https://janmikes.cz/slides/gitlab-ci-app-engine-autodeploy/): Péhápkaři Prague meetup #30, Prague, 13 September 2018, in Czech. From an empty Google Cloud project to a PHP app deployed by GitLab CI on every push.
- [The simplest GitLab CI pipeline ever](https://janmikes.cz/slides/simplest-gitlab-ci-pipeline/): PHPPrague 2018, Prague, 23 June 2018. Three lines of YAML, a green pipeline, and how GitLab CI jobs, stages and artifacts work.
- [Don’t be afraid to move on](https://janmikes.cz/slides/dont-be-afraid-to-move-on/): PHPlive 2018, Ostrava, 27 February 2018, in Czech. Changing jobs as a developer: your criteria, expectations vs reality, and leaving the comfort zone.
- [I tried DDD, and this is how it turned out](https://janmikes.cz/slides/i-tried-ddd/): Péhápkaři Prague meetup #25, Prague, 8 February 2018, in Czech. Mistakes from a first Domain-Driven Design project in PHP, with profiler numbers.
- [Less venting, more happiness](https://janmikes.cz/slides/less-venting-more-happiness/): Péhápkaři Prague meetup #23, Prague, 22 November 2017, in Czech. Integrity, honesty, validation and feedforward: small communication changes with a big effect at work.
- [How logging saved our butts](https://janmikes.cz/slides/logging-saved-us/): Péhápkaři Prague meetup #22, Prague, 12 October 2017, in Czech. A deleted production database, and how request logs got the lost orders back.
- [All talks](https://janmikes.cz/slides/)
